description: The trail is ~2.2kms in length with a 575m elevational change. It is a challenging hike up to the lake, so wear appropriate footwear/gear etc. The basic amenities of a pit toilet are offered at the parking area and at the top. These facilities may be improved in the future.
directions: Travel north (NW) of Mackenzie. Turn right at ~89.5km on the Parsnip West FSR. Access to this trail head is located ~3kms off the main FSR.

stats.Closure: Site currently inaccessible due to washout at 41km on Parsnip West FSR. No estimated time of reopening.

title: Canty Lake Trail
